**Max Verstappen** won the latest Formula 1 championship, which was the **2023 FIA Formula One World Championship**.

This was his third consecutive world title, which he secured driving for the **Red Bull Racing** team.

His team, **Oracle Red Bull Racing**, also won the **2023 Constructors' Championship**.
